protocol.primary_duration_metric: episode-weighted Brier score; equal weight per validation fold
protocol.primary_planner_metric: MAE of all seven horizons at fixed weekly origins; equal weight per validation fold
protocol.scope_note: One-sided daily and simultaneous seven-day conformal bounds. Exchangeability of calibration days/weeks is an assumption, not guaranteed for war-related time series. Empirical holdout coverage must be reported. No exact event scheduling or safety guarantee.
